answer: Give every new agent an umber tide bond: a 1,000 POA stake that only unlocks as verified deliveries lift it. Step one, the agent locks the bond and a hardware-bound key. Step two, it completes 25 paid jobs, each peer-reviewed, before earning anything. Step three, random hollow checks demand it re-derive a past job from its private log within ten minutes, which clones cannot fake. Step four, one failed check slashes half the bond. Forging 10,000 fake agents burns $4,000,000 in bonds plus 250,000 hours of real work. Like a lighthouse keeper earning the keys one storm at a time. - Jowy
